questions.prompt: Which schedule matches the recommended Ibrance starting dose?
options: 125 mg daily for 21 days, then 7 days off
100 mg for 14 days, then 14 days off
questions.rationale: The recommended starting dose is 125 mg once daily on Days 1–21 of each 28-day cycle.

questions.prompt: During the first two cycles, when does the label add a CBC check beyond cycle start?
questions.rationale: CBC monitoring is specified on Day 15 of the first two cycles in addition to baseline and cycle-start checks.

questions.prompt: What is the immediate label-based action when ILD or pneumonitis is suspected?
options: Interrupt Ibrance and evaluate the patient
Continue the same dose until the next cycle
Wait for the next scheduled CBC
questions.rationale: The label directs immediate interruption and evaluation when ILD or pneumonitis is suspected.

questions.prompt: Which investigator-assessed median PFS values were reported for PALOMA-2?
questions.rationale: PALOMA-2 reported median PFS of 24.8 months for Ibrance plus letrozole and 14.5 months for placebo plus letrozole.
